name: Orimoto Kaori
source: [url=/c23609]Hachiman's[/url] former classmate in middle school whom he confessed to once and got rejected. Currently goes to Kaihin Sougou High School. She is very easily amused and has a habit of saying "Chou ukeru (that's hilarious)" and "Sore aru! (that's it!)" but despite all this Kaori is smart and observant.
